title: Versioned git-tag releases for RayX.Dtcg: release-plz, one v1.0.0 tag, release and changelog for both crates, install by tag

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Parses `release-plz.toml` (Python `tomllib`, or pip's vendored `tomli` on Python 3.9) and asserts RPZ-1: the `[workspace]` keys, `semver_check = false`, `release_commits = "^(feat|fix|perf)"` and sample headers (`feat`, `fix(x)`, `perf` release; `docs:`, `refactor(x):`, `chore(agentx):`, `build:` do not), a comment stating the 1.x policy, the two `[[package]]` entries and their version group, and the `[changelog]` header, body (`## [{{ version }}] - {{ timestamp`, `commit.footers` with `Migration`) and skip parsers.
argv:
import re
try:
    import tomllib
except ModuleNotFoundError:  # Python < 3.11 (macOS python3 is 3.9): pip vendors tomli
    from pip._vendor import tomli as tomllib
c = tomllib.load(open("release-plz.toml", "rb"))
w = c["workspace"]
for key, want in {"git_only": True, "publish": False, "git_tag_enable": True, "git_tag_name": "v{{ version }}", "git_release_enable": True, "changelog_update": True}.items():
    assert w.get(key) == want, (key, w.get(key))
assert w.get("semver_check") is False, "semver_check stays off under the 1.x policy"
assert w.get("release_commits") == "^(feat|fix|perf)", w.get("release_commits")
commits = re.compile(w["release_commits"])
for message in ["feat: a", "fix(resolver): a", "perf: a", "feat(dtcg_runtime): a"]:
    assert commits.search(message), ("should release", message)
for message in ["docs: a", "docs(readme): a", "refactor(resolver): a", "test: a", "ci: a", "build: a", "chore(agentx): a", "chore(release): a"]:
    assert not commits.search(message), ("should not release", message)
assert "1.x" in open("release-plz.toml", encoding="utf-8").read(), "a comment states the 1.x policy"
packages = {p["name"]: p for p in c["package"]}
assert set(packages) == {"dtcg_runtime", "dtcg_runtime_derive"}, sorted(packages)
runtime, derive = packages["dtcg_runtime"], packages["dtcg_runtime_derive"]
assert runtime.get("changelog_path") == "./CHANGELOG.md", runtime.get("changelog_path")
assert runtime.get("changelog_include") == ["dtcg_runtime_derive"], runtime.get("changelog_include")
assert runtime.get("version_group") and runtime.get("version_group") == derive.get("version_group")
for key in ("git_tag_enable", "git_release_enable", "changelog_update", "release", "git_tag_name"):
    assert key not in runtime or runtime[key] is not False, ("dtcg_runtime must keep", key)
for key in ("git_tag_enable", "git_release_enable", "changelog_update"):
    assert derive.get(key) is False, ("dtcg_runtime_derive", key)
assert derive.get("release", True) is True and "git_tag_name" not in derive
log = c["changelog"]
assert "dtcg_runtime" in log["header"] and "Keep a Changelog" in log["header"] and "release-plz" in log["header"]
assert "Unreleased" not in log["header"]
assert "## [{{ version }}] - {{ timestamp" in log["body"]
assert "commit.footers" in log["body"] and "Migration" in log["body"], "the body renders Migration: footers"
skipped = {p["message"] for p in log["commit_parsers"] if p.get("skip")}
assert {"^chore\\(agentx\\)", "^chore\\(release\\)", "^chore\\(deps\\)"} <= skipped, skipped
print("release-plz config ok")

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Asserts VER-1 and VER-2 from the manifests, `Cargo.lock` and `CHANGELOG.md`: version and requirements `1.0.0`, both lock entries `1.0.0`, the derive dev-dependency path-only, the changelog starting with the configured header, one `## [1.0.0] - YYYY-MM-DD` heading, and its body equal to the `[Unreleased]` body of `7d55b99` (`git show`). If `main` gained Unreleased content after planning, amend the base commit in this check.
argv:
import re, subprocess
try:
    import tomllib
except ModuleNotFoundError:  # Python < 3.11 (macOS python3 is 3.9): pip vendors tomli
    from pip._vendor import tomli as tomllib
cargo = tomllib.load(open("Cargo.toml", "rb"))
assert cargo["workspace"]["package"]["version"] == "1.0.0", cargo["workspace"]["package"]["version"]
deps = cargo["workspace"]["dependencies"]
assert deps["dtcg_runtime"]["version"] == "1.0.0" and deps["dtcg_runtime_derive"]["version"] == "1.0.0", deps
derive = tomllib.load(open("crates/dtcg_runtime_derive/Cargo.toml", "rb"))
assert derive["dev-dependencies"]["dtcg_runtime"] == {"path": "../dtcg_runtime"}
lock = {p["name"]: p["version"] for p in tomllib.load(open("Cargo.lock", "rb"))["package"] if p["name"].startswith("dtcg_runtime")}
assert lock == {"dtcg_runtime": "1.0.0", "dtcg_runtime_derive": "1.0.0"}, lock
text = open("CHANGELOG.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
header = tomllib.load(open("release-plz.toml", "rb"))["changelog"]["header"]
assert text.startswith(header), "CHANGELOG.md must start with release-plz.toml's [changelog] header"
headings = re.findall(r"(?m)^## .*$", text)
assert len(headings) == 1 and re.fullmatch(r"## \[1\.0\.0\] - \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", headings[0]), headings
old = subprocess.run(["git", "show", "7d55b99:CHANGELOG.md"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
assert old.split("## [Unreleased]\n", 1)[1].strip() == text.split(headings[0] + "\n", 1)[1].strip(), "the 1.0.0 section must be the former Unreleased content"
print("version and changelog ok")

checks.descriptionMarkdown: The local release preview (RPZ-2, RPZ-3, RPZ-4). Needs release-plz 0.3.172 and cargo-semver-checks 0.51 on PATH (external tools, so never reused; cargo-semver-checks is required because CI has it, and the 1.x proof must hold with it present). It copies the working tree (uncommitted work included) with `rsync` into a temp directory, deletes the copy's tags, disables its push URL, adds a documented probe function to the copy's `dtcg_runtime` and commits a base; then: `release-plz release --dry-run` without a tag (first release), tag `v1.0.0`, and `release-plz update` after a docs-only commit (nothing), a derive fix (`1.0.1`, one root changelog) and a `feat` whose body states a break with a `Migration: RayX: …` footer (`1.1.0`, the `Migration:` line rendered), resetting to the base between scenarios; finally, under the configured `semver_check = false`, a `fix:` commit removing the probe must give `1.0.1` with no API check in the log (1.x policy). Log wording (`creation of tag 'v1.0.0'`, `no release method enabled`, `Checking API compatibility`, `API breaking changes`) comes from release-plz 0.3.172's source; if the real output differs only in wording, amend the assertion, never the behaviour it checks. The copy's `origin` points at a local stub HTTP server that answers 404: release-plz looks up the pull requests of HEAD on the forge even in a dry run (`should_release`), and GitHub answers a placeholder token with 401; with the stub (`--forge github`, GitHub Enterprise URL form) the lookup reads "commit not pushed", so the preview needs neither network access nor a token.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
command -v release-plz >/dev/null || { echo "release-plz (0.3.172, the release-plz/action@v0.5 default) is not on PATH"; exit 2; }
command -v cargo-semver-checks >/dev/null || { echo "cargo-semver-checks (0.51, the release-plz/action@v0.5 default) is not on PATH"; exit 2; }
release-plz --version
cargo semver-checks --version
py() { python3 -c "$(printf 'try:\n    import tomllib\nexcept ModuleNotFoundError:\n    from pip._vendor import tomli as tomllib\n%s\n' "$1")"; }
ver() { py 'print(tomllib.load(open("Cargo.toml", "rb"))["workspace"]["package"]["version"])'; }
lockver() { py 'print(" ".join(sorted(p["name"] + "@" + p["version"] for p in tomllib.load(open("Cargo.lock", "rb"))["package"] if p["name"].startswith("dtcg_runtime"))))'; }
src=$PWD
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
rsync -a --exclude /target --exclude /artifacts-temp "$src/" "$tmp/r/"
cd "$tmp/r"
test "$PWD" != "$src"
git tag -l | xargs -r git tag -d >/dev/null
git config user.name release-preview
git config user.email release-preview@example.invalid
git config commit.gpgsign false
git config tag.gpgsign false
git remote set-url --push origin no-push.invalid
# release-plz looks up the pull requests of HEAD on the forge (should_release), even in a dry run.
# A local stub answers 404 ("commit not pushed": no PRs), so the preview needs no network and no token.
stub_port=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s = socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1])')
mkdir "$tmp/stub"
python3 -m http.server "$stub_port" --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory "$tmp/stub" >"$tmp/stub.log" 2>&1 &
stub_pid=$!
trap 'kill "$stub_pid" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
for _ in $(seq 50); do python3 -c 'import socket, sys; socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])), 1)' "$stub_port" 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 0.2; done
git remote set-url origin "http://127.0.0.1:$stub_port/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg"
printf '\n/// Probe for the semver scenario of the release preview.\npub fn release_preview_probe() {}\n' >> crates/dtcg_runtime/src/lib.rs
git add -A
git commit -qm "chore: release preview base"
base=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
update() { release-plz update >"$tmp/$1.log" 2>&1 || { cat "$tmp/$1.log"; return 1; }; }
restore_base() { git reset -q --hard "$base"; git clean -qfd; }

echo "== first release (no tag): release-plz release --dry-run"
release-plz release --dry-run --forge github --git-token release-preview-placeholder >"$tmp/first.log" 2>&1 || { cat "$tmp/first.log"; exit 1; }
cat "$tmp/first.log"
grep -Fq "creation of tag 'v1.0.0'" "$tmp/first.log"
grep -Fq "creation of git release" "$tmp/first.log"
grep -Fq "dtcg_runtime_derive 1.0.0: no release method enabled" "$tmp/first.log"
if grep -Fq "dtcg_runtime_derive-v" "$tmp/first.log"; then echo "unexpected tag for dtcg_runtime_derive"; exit 1; fi
git tag v1.0.0

echo "== docs-only commit: no release"
printf '\n' >> docs/README.md
git commit -qam "docs: release preview docs-only change"
update docs
test "$(ver)" = 1.0.0
git diff --quiet
restore_base

echo "== derive fix: one version, one root changelog"
printf '\n// release preview\n' >> crates/dtcg_runtime_derive/src/lib.rs
git commit -qam "fix(dtcg_runtime_derive): release preview derive fix"
update derive
test "$(ver)" = 1.0.1
test "$(lockver)" = "dtcg_runtime@1.0.1 dtcg_runtime_derive@1.0.1"
test "$(grep -m1 '^## ' CHANGELOG.md | cut -c1-10)" = "## [1.0.1]"
grep -Eq '^## \[1\.0\.1\] - [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' CHANGELOG.md
grep -Fq 'release preview derive fix' CHANGELOG.md
test "$(grep -c '^# Changelog' CHANGELOG.md)" = 1
test ! -e crates/dtcg_runtime/CHANGELOG.md
test ! -e crates/dtcg_runtime_derive/CHANGELOG.md
grep -Fq 'dtcg_runtime = { path = "../dtcg_runtime" }' crates/dtcg_runtime_derive/Cargo.toml
cargo metadata --offline --format-version 1 >/dev/null
restore_base

echo "== feat that describes a break, with a Migration footer: minor (1.x policy)"
printf '\n// release preview\n' >> crates/dtcg_runtime/src/runtime.rs
git commit -qam "feat(dtcg_runtime): release preview change that breaks an API" -m "This body states the break; under the 1.x policy no ! and no BREAKING CHANGE footer are used." -m "Migration: RayX: release preview migration note"
update feat
test "$(ver)" = 1.1.0
test "$(lockver)" = "dtcg_runtime@1.1.0 dtcg_runtime_derive@1.1.0"
grep -Fq 'Migration: RayX: release preview migration note' CHANGELOG.md
cargo metadata --offline --format-version 1 >/dev/null
restore_base

echo "== semver_check off: a fix that removes a public function stays on 1.x"
test "$(py 'print(tomllib.load(open("release-plz.toml", "rb"))["workspace"]["semver_check"])')" = False
sed -i.bak -e '/release_preview_probe/d' -e '/Probe for the semver scenario/d' crates/dtcg_runtime/src/lib.rs && rm crates/dtcg_runtime/src/lib.rs.bak
git commit -qam "fix(dtcg_runtime): release preview removes a public function"
update semver
test "$(ver)" = 1.0.1
if grep -Eq 'Checking API compatibility|API breaking changes' "$tmp/semver.log"; then cat "$tmp/semver.log"; echo "an API check ran although semver_check = false"; exit 1; fi
echo "release preview ok"

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Asserts the documentation contract: the tag form in README and chapter 2 and no unpinned git form or "not on crates.io yet"; `docs/releasing.md` mentions its required topics (`release-plz.toml`, `RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN`, `Migration:`, `1.x`, `2.0.0` (the release-PR version check), `semver_check`, `git tag v`, `ruleset`, `--force-with-lease`, `ci.yml`, `dtcg_runtime_derive`, the `vX.Y.Z` dependency form) and tags every code block; chapter 14 links `releasing.md`, mentions release-plz, and no longer has the publish order, the crates.io-readme note, the `../RayX.Dtcg/crates` path or the hand-written changelog rule. Content quality is the reviewer's job. Every page that shows the git dependency (README, CLAUDE.md, every `docs/*.md`) must pin a `v*` tag (review finding F-S2-1).
argv:
import re
from pathlib import Path
pin = 'dtcg_runtime = { git = "https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg", tag = "v1.0.0" }'
for name in ("README.md", "docs/02-getting-started.md"):
    text = Path(name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert pin in text, (name, "tag form")
    assert 'git = "https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg" }' not in text, (name, "unpinned git dependency")
    assert "not on crates.io yet" not in text, name
# Every page that shows the git dependency pins a release tag (README, CLAUDE.md, every docs/*.md).
for path in [Path("README.md"), Path("CLAUDE.md"), *sorted(Path("docs").glob("*.md"))]:
    for number, line in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
        if 'git = "https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg"' in line:
            assert 'tag = "v' in line, (str(path), number, "unpinned git dependency", line)
releasing = Path("docs/releasing.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for needle in ("release-plz.toml", "RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN", "Migration:", "1.x", "2.0.0", "semver_check", "git tag v", "ruleset", "--force-with-lease", "ci.yml", "dtcg_runtime_derive", pin.replace("v1.0.0", "vX.Y.Z")):
    assert needle in releasing, ("docs/releasing.md", needle)
fences = re.findall(r"(?m)^```(.*)$", releasing)
assert len(fences) % 2 == 0 and all(f.strip() for f in fences[0::2]), ("untagged code block", fences)
chapter = Path("docs/14-architecture-and-contributing.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "releasing.md" in chapter and "release-plz" in chapter
for stale in ("Publish order", "crates.io readme", "../RayX.Dtcg/crates", "Record user-visible changes in `CHANGELOG.md`"):
    assert stale not in chapter, ("docs/14 still says", stale)
print("release docs ok")

`CLAUDE.md` equals `AGENTS.md`; its `## Releases` section names Conventional Commits, the `1.x` policy, `Migration:` footers, the release pull request, the fetch/rebase and `--force-with-lease` push, and `docs/releasing.md`; Consumers names the tag form and no longer the `../RayX.Dtcg/crates` path; the AgentX block is intact.
argv:

checks.descriptionMarkdown: AgentX's workflow YAML checker (syntax and duplicate keys GitHub rejects) over both workflows. The script path is the installed AgentX skill's; adjust it to the local install when resolving the sprint.

Ruby (`YAML.safe_load`) structure assertions on `release-plz.yml` per WF-1: triggers (`push` to `main`, `workflow_dispatch`), the two jobs with guard, permissions and concurrency, `release-pr` with `needs: release` and `release` with no `needs`, checkout with `fetch-depth: 0` and the token, the toolchain step, `release-plz/action@v0.5` with the matching `command` and `GITHUB_TOKEN`, no cargo test/clippy/build/check steps, `RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN` the only secret.
argv:
require "yaml"
path = ".github/workflows/release-plz.yml"
text = File.read(path)
w = YAML.safe_load(text)
on = w["on"] || w[true]
raise "trigger" unless on["push"] == { "branches" => ["main"] } && on.key?("workflow_dispatch") && on.keys.size == 2
jobs = w["jobs"]
raise "jobs #{jobs.keys}" unless jobs.keys.sort == ["release", "release-pr"]
raise "release-pr must need release" unless Array(jobs["release-pr"]["needs"]) == ["release"]
raise "release must not wait on another job" if jobs["release"].key?("needs")
jobs.each do |name, job|
  raise "#{name}: guard" unless job["if"] == "github.repository == 'rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg'"
  raise "#{name}: permissions" unless job["permissions"]["contents"] == "write"
  raise "#{name}: pull-requests" if name == "release-pr" && job["permissions"]["pull-requests"] != "write"
  raise "#{name}: concurrency" unless job["concurrency"]
  steps = job["steps"]
  checkout = steps.find { |s| s["uses"].to_s.start_with?("actions/checkout@") }
  raise "#{name}: checkout" unless checkout && checkout["with"]["fetch-depth"] == 0 && checkout["with"]["token"] == "${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN }}"
  raise "#{name}: toolchain" unless steps.any? { |s| s["uses"].to_s.start_with?("actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@") }
  action = steps.find { |s| s["uses"] == "release-plz/action@v0.5" }
  raise "#{name}: action" unless action && action["with"]["command"] == name && action["env"]["GITHUB_TOKEN"] == "${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN }}"
  raise "#{name}: runs tests" if steps.any? { |s| s["run"].to_s =~ /cargo\s+(test|clippy|build|check)/ }
end
raise "secrets" unless text.scan(/secrets\.([A-Za-z_]+)/).flatten.uniq == ["RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN"]
puts "release workflow ok"

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Reads the repository's rulesets with `gh api` (read-only) and requires an active `tag` ruleset including `refs/tags/v*` whose rules contain `deletion` and `update` and which has no bypass actors (the owner's "Release tags" ruleset; it passed when the plan was amended). GitHub state, so never reused.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
found=0
for id in $(gh api repos/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg/rulesets --jq '.[] | select(.target == "tag") | .id'); do
  line=$(gh api "repos/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg/rulesets/$id" --jq '[.enforcement, (.conditions.ref_name.include | join(",")), ([.rules[].type] | sort | join(",")), ("bypass=" + (.bypass_actors | length | tostring))] | join(" ")')
  echo "tag ruleset $id: $line"
  case "$line" in
    "active refs/tags/v* "*deletion*update*" bypass=0") found=1 ;;
  esac
done
test "$found" = 1
echo "tag ruleset ok"

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Read-only GitHub checks with `gh` and `git ls-remote`: the latest Release-plz run on `main` succeeded; the Release `v1.0.0` exists, not draft or prerelease, and its notes contain the 1.0.0 section ("Official conformance corpus"); `Cargo.toml` at `v1.0.0` says `1.0.0`; `refs/tags/v1.0.0` exists and no per-crate tag; no open `release-plz-*` pull request. GitHub state, so never reused. It also requires the Release title `v1.0.0` and `git_release_name = "v{{ version }}"` in `release-plz.toml` (review finding F-S3-1).
argv:
set -euo pipefail
repo=rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg
run=$(gh run list --repo "$repo" --workflow release-plz.yml --branch main --limit 1 --json conclusion,headSha --jq '.[0] | .conclusion + " " + .headSha')
echo "latest Release-plz run on main: $run"
test "${run%% *}" = success
release=$(gh release view v1.0.0 --repo "$repo" --json name,tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease --jq '[.name, .tagName, .isDraft, .isPrerelease] | map(tostring) | join(" ")')
echo "release: $release"
test "$release" = "v1.0.0 v1.0.0 false false"
# Future Releases are titled like the tag too (review finding F-S3-1).
grep -qx 'git_release_name = "v{{ version }}"' release-plz.toml
gh release view v1.0.0 --repo "$repo" --json body --jq .body | grep -Fq 'Official conformance corpus'
gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' "repos/$repo/contents/Cargo.toml?ref=v1.0.0" | grep -q '^version = "1.0.0"$'
tags=$(git ls-remote --tags --refs "https://github.com/$repo" | awk '{print $2}')
echo "$tags"
echo "$tags" | grep -qx 'refs/tags/v1.0.0'
if echo "$tags" | grep -q 'dtcg_runtime'; then echo "unexpected per-crate tag"; exit 1; fi
open=$(gh pr list --repo "$repo" --state open --json headRefName --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith("release-plz-")) | .headRefName')
test -z "$open"
echo "first release ok"

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Creates a scratch library crate in a new system temp directory (outside the repository and any workspace), adds the tag dependency, `cargo check`s it with toolchain 1.95.0 and requires `cargo tree` to show `dtcg_runtime v1.0.0` and `dtcg_runtime_derive v1.0.0` from `https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg?tag=v1.0.0#`. Fetches from GitHub, so never reused.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
d=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
cd "$d"
cargo new --lib --vcs none --quiet dtcg_tag_consumer
cd dtcg_tag_consumer
printf 'dtcg_runtime = { git = "https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg", tag = "v1.0.0" }\n' >> Cargo.toml
printf 'pub use dtcg_runtime::DtcgRuntime;\n' > src/lib.rs
cargo check --quiet
cargo tree --prefix none | sort -u | grep -F '?tag=v1.0.0#'
cargo tree --prefix none | grep -Fq 'dtcg_runtime v1.0.0 (https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg?tag=v1.0.0#'
cargo tree --prefix none | grep -Fq 'dtcg_runtime_derive v1.0.0 (proc-macro) (https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg?tag=v1.0.0#'
echo "tag consumer ok"

sprints.title: release-plz configuration, version 1.0.0 and the 1.0.0 changelog, proven by a local release preview

tasks.title: release-plz.toml for one tag, one release and one root changelog
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Read `../RayX.CLI/release-plz.toml` (reference repository) and write `release-plz.toml` per RPZ-1: the CLI's `[workspace]` keys with `git_release_enable = true` (no dist here), the CLI's `release_commits = "^(feat|fix|perf)"`, `semver_check = false`, the two `[[package]]` entries with `version_group = "dtcg"`, and the CLI's `[changelog]` with a header naming `dtcg_runtime` and `dtcg_runtime_derive` (no `## [Unreleased]`) and, per entry, one indented `Migration: <value>` line for each footer whose `token` is `Migration` (git-cliff's `commit.footers`; d-changelog-from-commits). Comment the file like the CLI's (why git-only, why one version group, the tag form) and state the 1.x policy (d-stay-on-1x: why `semver_check` is off and `!` is never used). Commit, e.g. `build(release): configure release-plz for git-tag releases`.

tasks.title: Version 1.0.0 and the 1.0.0 changelog section
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: In the root `Cargo.toml` set `[workspace.package] version = "1.0.0"` and `version = "1.0.0"` on the `dtcg_runtime` and `dtcg_runtime_derive` entries of `[workspace.dependencies]`; refresh `Cargo.lock` (`cargo update --workspace --offline`). Touch nothing under `crates/`. In `CHANGELOG.md` replace the header with exactly the `[changelog] header` of `release-plz.toml` and the `## [Unreleased]` heading with `## [1.0.0] - <today>`, keeping everything below it byte-for-byte (VER-2). Commit, e.g. `chore(release): version 1.0.0`.

tasks.title: Prove the release behaviour locally under the 1.x policy
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Install the versions `release-plz/action@v0.5` uses (re-check its `action.yml` defaults first): `cargo install --locked release-plz@0.3.172` and `cargo install --locked cargo-semver-checks@0.51.0` (crates.io, user cargo bin, not committed). Run `check-release-preview` (it works on uncommitted changes too: it copies the working tree to a temp directory; never run its scenario commands in the repository). Fix configuration for wrong behaviour; amend only assertion wording that differs from release-plz's real output, and record each such difference as a finding. The scenarios prove the 1.x policy: a break-describing `feat` with a `Migration:` footer gives `1.1.0` with the footer rendered (if git-cliff does not parse the footer, fix the template or the footer form, not the assertion), and an API removal under `fix` gives `1.0.1` with cargo-semver-checks installed. Do not change the toolchain. Keep raw logs, if any, under `artifacts-temp/agentx/dtcg-releases/`.

sprints.title: Release documentation, install by tag and contributor guidance

tasks.title: docs/releasing.md and chapter 14
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `docs/releasing.md` per DOC-1, modelled on `../RayX.CLI/docs/releasing.md` minus cargo-dist (release-plz creates the Release; no installers or attestations), with the 1.x policy (d-stay-on-1x) and the release-PR CI statement of CI-1. Rework chapter 14 per DOC-3 (Releases, the source-layout tree, Working with RayX; keep CI accurate). Leave `ci.yml` untouched (CI-1). Tag every code block. Commit, e.g. `docs(release): document git-tag releases with release-plz`.

tasks.title: README and chapter 2 install by release tag
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Rework README `## Installation` and chapter 2's "Add the dependency" per DOC-2 with `dtcg_runtime = { git = "https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.Dtcg", tag = "v1.0.0" }`, keeping the surrounding notes and the `toml` code-block tags. Optionally link `docs/releasing.md` from the README Development section. Commit, e.g. `docs(readme): depend on a release tag`.

tasks.title: Releases and Consumers in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `## Releases` section and rewrite `## Consumers` per DOC-4 in `CLAUDE.md`, then copy the file to `AGENTS.md` so they stay identical (AgentX block untouched). Keep it short; details live in `docs/releasing.md`. Commit, e.g. `docs(agents): add release and push rules`. After the s2 checkpoint, push s1 and s2 to `main` per the push policy (no workflow yet, so nothing is released) so `ci.yml` checks them before s3.

sprints.title: First release: verified prerequisites, the release-plz workflow and v1.0.0 (pre-approved push), used from a scratch consumer

tasks.title: Verify RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN and the v* tag ruleset
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: The owner created both on 2026-10-18 (amendment 1 C). Verify only, read-only: `check-release-secret` (secret names) and `check-tag-ruleset` (the "Release tags" ruleset: active, `refs/tags/v*`, `update` and `deletion` restricted, no bypass). Never create, change or read the value of either. If one is missing or different, stop and report it to the owner. Note in `docs/releasing.md` (t04 already describes them) nothing new unless the verification differs.

tasks.title: The release-plz workflow
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `.github/workflows/release-plz.yml` per WF-1 from `../RayX.CLI/.github/workflows/release-plz.yml`: this repository's guard, `ci.yml`'s `actions/checkout` major, a header comment that fits this repository (release-plz creates the Release; `ci.yml` tests pull requests and pushes). Commit, e.g. `ci(release): tag releases with release-plz`, but do not push it here: its push is the release (t09). Before that push, run this task's two static checks once by hand.

tasks.title: Release v1.0.0 and use it from a scratch consumer
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Preconditions: `check-release-secret` and `check-tag-ruleset` pass, s1 and s2 are on `origin/main` with a green `ci.yml` run (`gh run list --workflow ci.yml --branch main`), and `Cargo.toml` still says `1.0.0`. If today differs from the `## [1.0.0]` date, correct it (`docs(changelog): date the 1.0.0 release`). The owner pre-approved this push (amendment 1 D): `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease origin main`, then watch the Release-plz run (`gh run watch`) and verify FIRST-1 and FIRST-2. If the run fails at checkout or the tag push, inspect the log: a permission or authentication failure means the PAT's repository access does not include RayX.Dtcg; report that to the owner (fix: add the repository to the PAT) and do not retry blindly; after the owner's fix, re-run with `workflow_dispatch`. Use the by-hand fallback only with the owner's go-ahead and record why.
